{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Sauces]]

'''Brown gravy''' is a basic [[Cookbook:Gravy|gravy]] similar to what you get using a pouch of supermarket instant gravy.

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] finely-[[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Stock|vegetable stock]] (or beef or mushroom stock)
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Yeast extract|yeast extract]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Sautéing|Sauté]] the onion in the oil over medium heat with salt and pepper, until the onion begins to turn golden brown. Add the flour and stir. A [[Cookbook:Roux|roux]] should form; cook it for several minutes until it starts to darken.
# Add the stock and stir until smooth. Add the yeast extract—as the gravy warms it will become incorporated. Taste and season if necessary. When the gravy simmers, it is done.
# [[Cookbook:Strainer|Strain]] into a gravy boat or other serving container and allow to cool a few minutes before serving.
